verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs describe search with a wide array of filters, including a channel filter (channel:design) and a channels:public filter that searches across all public channels, so channel-scoped and broad history search is documented. The pack never mentions sender or date filters. A single older community remark that search "barely works" is vague and not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: documented sender filter, documented date/time-range filter, admin-specific search scope, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can search the full message history with filters like sender, channel, and date

citations.quote: channel:design has:image new logo: Search for messages in #design that include an image and contain the keywords new and logo.
channels:public: Search messages in all public and web-public channels.
Zulip also offers a wide array of search filters, which can be used on their own, or in combination with keywords.
